text: 【证监会主席吴清：A股总市值突破100万亿元】中国证监会主席吴清11月14日在2026中国资本市场学术年会上表示，资本市场板块建设不断向纵深推进，错位发展、功能互补的股权市场体系基本健全，A股总市值突破100万亿元。交易所与银行间市场共同构成的中国债券市场规模超210万亿元，科创债、绿色债、REITs精准对接国家战略需求。涵盖商品、金融各类期货期权品种170多个，基本覆盖国民经济主要产业领域。
text_en: [CSRC Chairman Wu Qing: Total A-share market capitalization exceeds RMB 100 trillion] CSRC Chairman Wu Qing said on November 14 at the 2026 China Capital Market Academic Annual Meeting that the development of capital market segments continues to advance in depth, a equity market system featuring differentiated development and complementary functions has basically taken shape, and total A-share market capitalization has exceeded RMB 100 trillion. China's bond market, formed jointly by exchanges and the interbank market, exceeds RMB 210 trillion, with science and innovation bonds, green bonds and REITs precisely meeting national strategic needs. There are more than 170 futures and options products covering commodities and financial categories, basically covering the main industrial sectors of the national economy.
